tasks.spec:
You are a Python 3.12 engineer fixing a shared-runtime defect in freytag-forge, approved by Brandon (plan: .plans/1a-opening-and-truck-feedback-plan.md, ruling 1 and Step 3 first bullet; read them). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (branch 1a-opening-and-truck-feedback). No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit.

YOU MAY EDIT: storygame/runtime/capture.py, storygame/runtime/seating.py, a NEW tests/test_already_aboard_engine_reply.py, and existing tests under tests/ ONLY where a pin truly changes because of this fix (list each in your report; tests/test_observation_mode.py::test_already_aboard_turn_is_narrated_without_engine_step pins the OLD behaviour and must be rewritten to the new one). Never edit data/, docs/, bench/, packages/, .plans/, scripts/. Shared runtime has NO story names (no Kristin, Michelle, truck, laptop, driver, passenger, drawer): build strings from world names and generic words only. No command keyword tables.

THE DEFECT (measured live, 6 of 6 replicates): when the protagonist is already seated in a vehicle and the player repeats a pure boarding command ('get in the truck'), the narrator writes an exit from the vehicle, and in 2 of 6 the exit was committed. Cause in WorldCapture.before_turn (capture.py): stand_before_leave runs BEFORE board_vehicle, so the 'must stand first' question can move the protagonist out of the seat, and then boarding re-seats or the narrator improvises. Also commit 289e2575 delegated the already-aboard result to the narrator when observe_automatically is on (the `already_aboard_in_observation` lines), which Brandon has reversed.

REQUIRED BEHAVIOUR (Brandon's ruling, 2026-11-02): when self.engine_refusal is on and the protagonist is currently seated in a visible vehicle's seat, evaluate the already-aboard case FIRST, before stand_before_leave, take_before_put and seat_before_use. If board_vehicle reports already_aboard (i.e. the boards question answered yes AND only_boards_vehicle answered yes for the seated vehicle), the turn is consumed by the engine: set record['engine_refusal'] to a short engine-owned sentence "You're already in <the vehicle name>." (article handling like fixed_refusal._fixed_article_name: lower-case names get 'the ', others use the existing _with_article helper; reuse those helpers, do not duplicate), and return from before_turn early enough that NO standing, taking, seating, observation request, narrator call or world mutation happens (the existing engine path at storygame/runtime/engine.py ~line 480 already handles record['engine_refusal']: it discards capture, restores the snapshot and returns EngineRefusalTurn without advancing pacing; Brandon chose that: the redundant command leaves the clock untouched). Keep the record keys the engine and later readers expect (look at how the fixed-refusal branch builds `record`; include at least command, steps=[], boarding_asked True, boarding_command_consumed False, issues, engine_refusal, and the same keys so consumers do not KeyError). Do not change engine.py unless a test proves it is required (say why).

UNCHANGED: compound commands (boards yes, only_boards no) fall through to the existing flow; any command that names a different vehicle or is not a boarding command; explicit exit, seat change and drive; protagonist not seated; engine_refusal off (legacy path stays exactly as before, including the existing already_aboard behaviour for it). Avoid asking the model questions twice when the answer is not already-aboard: if the pre-check does not consume the turn, reuse its boards answer for the later board_vehicle call where world state is unchanged (the JevPrefetch adapter in before_turn may already cache identical questions; check and only add reuse if it does not). If you change seating.py, keep board_vehicle's signature backward compatible. World-only predicates belong in packages/worldkeeper as World methods; you do not need one and must not edit packages/.

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_already_aboard_engine_reply.py (hermetic; copy the product-wired approach in tests/test_observation_mode.py: WorldCapture attached with engine_refusal=True, scripted question answers, stubbed provider): (a) continuity-initiative package, protagonist seated, 'Get in the truck.' with boards yes and only_boards yes and stand-first question answered YES (the case that used to leave the seat): record['engine_refusal'] is the sentence, protagonist's parent and seat unchanged, vehicle parent unchanged, laptop custody unchanged, narrator provider never called; (b) through the real engine path if there is a helper (see tests/test_engine_refusal*.py or similar), the result is EngineRefusalTurn and the turn index and facts are unchanged afterwards; (c) compound 'Get in the truck and look for my laptop.' (only_boards no) is NOT consumed; (d) explicit 'Get out of the truck.' still stands her up (boards no); (e) boarding from outside still seats her; (f) engine_refusal off leaves old behaviour; (g) a synthetic second package with a differently named vehicle and seat gives the analogous sentence with its names.

DONE WHEN the check passes. Report: files changed, existing tests updated and why, whether engine.py needed a change, and anything you could not do.
